domain_restrictions: frac(x) is constrained by inequality 0 <= frac(x) < 1
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every real number x, define n = floor(x) and f = frac(x). Then x = n + f and the fractional part satisfies 0 <= f and f < 1.

variables.name: x
variables.role: input to floor and fractional part

variables.name: f
variables.role: fractional part value of x, equal to frac(x)

variables.name: n
variables.role: floor value of x, equal to floor(x)

witness_dependencies: The integer n depends on x via n = floor(x)
The real f depends on x via f = frac(x)
The equality x = n + f uses the same x-dependent choices n = floor(x) and f = frac(x)

statement_nl: For every real number x, x = floor(x) + frac(x), and 0 <= frac(x) < 1.
